acip: DE YANG TSOGS GSOG PAR 'DOD NA YAR NGO DANG, SGRIB PA SBYONG BA 'DOD NA MAR NGO ZHES GANG RUNG GCIG GIS CHOG PA 'DRA ZHIG 'DUG KYANG GNYIS KA MA CHAG PA NI GAL CHE'O,,
wylie: de yang tshogs gsog par 'dod na yar ngo dang, sgrib pa sbyong ba 'dod na mar ngo zhes gang rung gcig gis chog pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang gnyis ka ma chag pa ni gal che'o
english: Now it has been said, correctly, that if you're looking to collect new good karma you can do so powerfully during the Offering of the Tenth that falls during the waxing of the moon; and that if you hope to remove old bad karma it is well done on the Tenth during the moon's waning.  This would seem to imply that you could observe either one of these two; but in truth you should be aware that it's extremely important never to break your observance of both tenth days. The Yoga of Offering Torma Cakes
